newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Big C Super in US$90 million term loan.
newsitem.headline: Big C Super in US$90 million term loan.

text.p: Big C Supercenter Public Co Ltd has launched a US$90 million term loan facility, coordinating arranger Overseas Union Bank said on Tuesday.
The facility carries a maturity of five years and has put and call options at the end of year three. It pays a margin of 142.5 basis points over the Singapore Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 159.2 basis points.
There is a commitment fee of 25 basis points and a put waver fee of 37.5 basis points.
Proceeds of the loan will be used for the company's expansion.
The deal is secured over the land, buildings, and equipment of certain of the company's discount stores.
The other arrangers are AFC Merchant Bank, Sime International Bank Labuan, Standard Chartered Bank and Union Europeenne de CIC's Singapore branch.
Replies are due in the week of June 23.
